result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but there are a few visual issues: horizontal content is clipped at the right edge in two places (the category filter chips and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards), which is expected for carousels but the third card's title is awkwardly truncated mid-word without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card and its title are cut off at the right screen edge, with the name truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or fade gradient to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade gradient or partial-card peek with consistent padding so users understand the row scrolls horizontally; ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis at a word boundary.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, again without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade or ensure the next chip peeks in consistently to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Inconsistent vertical alignment in the 'Fastest near you' row: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has its image top-aligned differently and lacks the dark background treatment of the other two cards, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card image aspect ratios, backgrounds, and badge placement across all cards in the horizontal row for visual consistency.
